title: Junior Administrative Assistant and Senior Computer Assistant – 17 Posts
qualification: Junior Administrative Assistant: || Must be a Graduate from a recognized university. || Must have a Certificate Course in Computer Word Processing or an equivalent qualification from a recognized university/institute. || Must have a typing speed of 40 words per minute on a computer. || Senior Computer Assistant: || B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science/Information Technology, or || MCA from any recognized university.
salary: Entry pay of Rs. 21,400 per month in Pay Matrix Level-7 of TSCS (Revised Pay) (First Amendment) Rules, 2018, subject to revision by the Government from time to time
age_limit: As on 10.08.2026, candidates must be: || Not below 18 years of age || Not more than 40 years of age for candidates of other (general) categories || Not more than 45 years of age for candidates belonging to Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes || This age limit applies uniformly to both the Junior Administrative Assistant and Senior Computer Assistant posts.
application_fee: Fees must be paid online through Credit Card (Visa/Master/RuPay), Net Banking, Debit Card (Visa/Master/RuPay), Wallets, Cash Cards, or UPI only. No other mode of payment is accepted, and bank charges may apply. || Fees once deposited will not be refunded or adjusted against any other recruitment in future. || ST/SC candidates belonging to other states must apply as general category candidates and pay the fee applicable to the general category.
